inlines.v: UPRIGHTLY, adverb 1. In a direction perpendicular to the plane of the horizon; in an erect position. 2. Honestly; with strict observance of rectitude; as, to live uprightly He that walketh uprightly walketh surely. Proverbs 10:9.
